composition_label: Guided setup -> Ticket triage & routing -> Product comparison -> Feedback analysis

construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory using synthetic fixtures only.

input.schema_version: Integer 1; unknown keys are rejected throughout the schema.
input.synthetic: Boolean true; all supplied fixture data is explicitly synthetic.
input.guided: customer_id, nonempty steps [{id, requires: [step_id], required: bool}], ordered completed_steps, preferences
input.triage: rules [{category, keywords, priority, owner, preferences}], default {category, priority, owner, preferences}, tickets [{id, customer_id, text}]
input.products: Nonempty list [{id, name, attributes}]. Exactly price, memory, weight, brand after alias normalization.
input.feedback: List [{id, ticket_id, product_id, text}]. References must resolve.
input.feedback_themes: Object mapping theme names to nonempty keyword lists.
input.preferences: Optional max_price_usd, min_memory_gb, max_weight_kg, preferred_brand, weights. If weights supplied, all price_usd/memory_gb/weight_kg/brand keys are required, finite nonnegative, and at least one positive.
input.product_units: Numeric attributes are {value: finite positive number, unit: string}. USD; GB/TB/MB (1024-based); kg/g/lb. Brand is normalized text.

output_envelope.results: Accumulated validated stage outputs, in execution order

shared_schema.errors: {schema_version: 1, status: error, error: string}; CLI exits 2 for validation, decoding or file errors; success prints one JSON object and exits 0.
shared_schema.validation: Shared primitive/schema validators validate the request. validate_state enforces exact envelope, stage order and deterministic recomputation of all accumulated results before and after every handoff. Stages do not mutate their input.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated customer identity, readiness and preferences; required incomplete steps prevent routing.
Validated routed tickets with category, accountable owner, priority and effective preferences; route preferences override onboarding preferences by key.
Validated per-ticket normalized product rows, rank, score and recommendation; groups retain routing owner/category and comparison context.

behavior.guided: Rejects unknown prerequisites, cycles, repeated completions and out-of-order completion. Tracks ready/blocked/completed, counts, total progress and required remaining. Optional unfinished steps do not prevent triage. Partial progress is available through guided_setup; full CLI pipeline reports error when required steps remain.
behavior.triage: Canonical Unicode word/phrase matches. Most distinct keyword hits wins; ties prefer higher configured priority then earlier rule. Default fallback always has an owner. All tickets belong to the one onboarded customer.
behavior.compare: Normalizes aliases and units; rejects ambiguous duplicate aliases. Side-by-side table includes every catalog product, hard-constraint eligibility and rejection reasons. Eligible products ranked by weighted min-max utilities; lower price/weight and higher memory are preferred. Constant attributes have utility 1. Brand scores 1 for preferred brand (or all when absent). Scores rounded to six decimals; ties by product ID. Weights scaled before summing. No-match results have empty ranking and null recommendation.
behavior.feedback: NFKC/casefold/punctuation/whitespace deduplication within ticket and product, preserving every source ID and exact original bounded excerpt. Theme matching uses canonical word/phrase boundaries; a group can support multiple themes. Theme counts are unique groups, not raw duplicates. Unmatched groups tracked. Feedback for compared but ineligible products is allowed and has null rank/score.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, timestamps, network calls or LLM use. Same request gives identical output. Rule order is a documented final triage tiebreaker; product ID is ranking tiebreaker.
behavior.empty_batches: Empty ticket and feedback batches allowed; catalog and onboarding steps must remain nonempty.

included: One integrated pipeline and common envelope/validation layer
Prerequisite graph validation and onboarding progress
Configurable deterministic categorization, priority and accountable routing
Normalized side-by-side comparison and explainable preference ranking
Scoped deduplication, configurable themes and traceable verbatim excerpts
CLI and unittest fixtures with no external dependencies
excluded: Live providers, LLM callbacks, web/network access and external services
Authentication, persistence services, concurrent processing and production deployment
Currency conversion and arbitrary product attribute ontologies
Semantic similarity deduplication, sentiment inference or learned ranking
Interactive prompts or UI; onboarding input is a validated completion event sequence

coverage: Every stage and all three handoffs
Prerequisites, cycles, progress, optional steps and incomplete onboarding
Configured categorization, routing fallback, priority and rule tiebreakers
Units, exact converted constraint boundary, preference weights and deterministic ranking
No eligible products and empty batches
Scoped deduplication, multiple themes and exact source evidence
Schema, numeric, unit, alias, reference and duplicate-ID errors
CLI subprocess success, usage and missing-file errors
Malformed/duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON, schema, permission and decoding errors
test_outcomes.repair_verified: Initial unit test exposed binary rounding in g-to-kg conversion. Decimal-based conversion and an exact-boundary regression test were added; all 34 tests and the CLI then passed.
